title: Per-endpoint soft radial_4 assignment under measured leftover sigma (Yeh-style), not the Exp2 matrix mean
why_new: Exp2 averaged six planted count matrices (+0.4 to +1.4 points stability, keep radial_4). That is a matrix smoother, not P(node | endpoint). C2 builds the per-endpoint object.

model.endpoint_jitter: delta ~ N(0, sigma_s^2 I3), independent per endpoint and per sample
model.sigma_s: V1 median_of_voxel_medians_mm for that session / 1.5382 (median of a 3D Maxwell |delta| = 1.5382 sigma)
assumptions: isotropic, spatially constant sigma per session (V1 voxel maps are flat labeled-voxel vectors without a stored grid; spatial sigma is v2)
the two ends of a streamline jitter independently (real phi is smooth; coherent shift is the U plant)

outputs_per_session.C0: hard radial_4 count (must match identity_count; Spearman >= 0.999)
outputs_per_session.Esoft: expected count E[C] under jitter (soft connectome)
outputs_per_session.F: edge leakage = 1 - sum_{streamlines hard on ij} P(stay on ij) / C0_ij; 0 if C0_ij = 0
outputs_per_session.end_stay: histogram of per-endpoint P(stay on hard node)

dev_exam_planted_y.what_it_is: Does a plant-free, per-endpoint score built only from measured leftover sigma rank the same 1 mm movers U ranks?
dev_exam_planted_y.y: same locked 1 mm event as U and C (relchange > 0.25, count >= 10, max over +-1 mm six axes)
dev_exam_planted_y.mask: same as C: triu, max(C0 and all 18 planted maps) >= 10
metrics: invented count>=10 edges in Esoft vs C0
dev_exam_planted_y.win: Spearman > 0.5 AND AUROC > 0.7 on >= 2 of 3 development sessions AND >= 2 of 3 confirmation sessions (U thresholds, not retuned)
dev_exam_planted_y.fail: keep U as the ranker; C2 soft assigner stays a description
dev_exam_planted_y.not_a_claim: planted y; this is not leftover calibration

leftover_exam.status: blocked until Kirby KKI849 and Boekel pp01 both sessions have dkt_connectome_count.csv with empty_nodes = 0

amendment_2026-10-20.retest_sigma_rule: Kirby/Boekel have no A5 SyN ensemble (driver not on disk). Primary sigma = median of the six V1 session medians (0.7663 mm) / 1.5382 = 0.4981 mm, same for every retest session.
amendment_2026-10-20.secondary_if_A5_rerun: per-session V1 sigma on run-1; reported beside the primary, never replacing it
amendment_2026-10-20.runner: retest_pack.py (pack on ses-1 / run-1 only; y from the two hard count CSVs)

amendment_2026-10-20b.trigger: development E[C] invented 2-12 count>=10 edges per session (up to 0.45% of eligible), above the locked 0.001
amendment_2026-10-20b.primary_rule_unchanged: soft-connectome win still requires invent_frac <= 0.001 on both pairs; not relaxed

secondary_descriptive.invented_edge_profile: development only: for each invented edge, hard C0, E[C], and whether C0 in [5,10) (near-threshold) vs < 5; reported, not used to rescue the rule
secondary_descriptive.hard_crossing_rate: on each retest pair: fraction of eligible edges that are >=10 in one hard run and <10 in the other (what re-scanning alone does); context beside invent_frac, cannot overturn the rule
secondary_descriptive.threshold_uncertainty: per edge P(count>=10) over the S jittered samples; edges with 0.1 < P < 0.9 are flagged 'threshold-uncertain'. Reported as an uncertainty output, not a replacement connectome. On retest: fraction of hard run-1 vs run-2 threshold crossings that fall on flagged edges

leftover_exam.y: moved between run-1 and run-2 hard connectomes (relchange > 0.25, max count >= 10)
leftover_exam.inputs: F, Esoft, U, Ucal computed on run-1 only
leftover_exam.primary: AUROC of F vs U vs Ucal on leftover y (pre-specified ranking comparison)
secondary: ECE of a monotone map of F fit on development planted y only, tested on leftover y
moved-fraction relchange(Esoft_run1, C_run2) vs relchange(C0_run1, C_run2) with invent_frac <= 0.001
leftover_exam.control: tracking-only noise: re-run tckgen with a new seed on run-1 to estimate the floor of run-1 vs run-2 moves not due to registration
leftover_exam.win_soft_connectome: Esoft moved-fraction lower than hard C0 on both subjects with invent_frac <= 0.001
leftover_exam.fail: report; keep radial_4 (Yeh 2019) and say so

forbidden: tune sigma, S, or cuts after seeing any AUROC or ECE
